text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne, a full stack developer with 7 years of experience working with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS.

I’d be a strong fit for this role because I’m comfortable building and maintaining web apps, working across the stack, and adapting quickly to new technologies. I’m especially interested in learning and applying PHP, Laravel, and AWS services where needed, and I’m used to collaborating closely with teams to keep bugs, updates, and feature requests moving smoothly.

I also value clean implementation, SEO-friendly development, and staying current with new tools and ideas. I’d welcome the chance to support your team, work closely with marketing, and contribute with a practical, innovative mindset.
